claim: The centre of the Pauli 3^(1+12) acting on the Niemeier A8^3 lattice VOA is the dual Z_3 of the E8^3 -> A8^3 orbifold of 68df33f: the shift orbifold of N(A8^3) by u = (6,0,0) has 27 glue words, is even unimodular, and has 216 + 6*84 = 720 roots, each A8 completing to E8, so it is E8^3. Hence E8^3 -> A8^3 is the exact lattice analogue of Leech -> Moonshine, with the same extraspecial 3^(1+12) core.

parallel.E8cubed_to_A8cubed: 3^(1+12) Pauli, centre = glue grading omega^(c_1), reverse orbifold returns V_E8^3

literature.Sagaki-Shimakura arXiv:1402.0143: A8^3 excluded from Miyamoto Z3 orbifold (fixed rank 8 not in 6Z)
literature.Hoehn-Scheithauer (rank-14 GKM): their Z2-twist refers to root lattice A_3^8, not A_8^3
